title: Evaluation of mTORC1 signaling in mouse atherosclerotic macrophages by flow cytometry and immunofluorescence
protocol: Prepare 1.7 mL tubes containing pre-cooled DMEM medium, OCT medium and disposable base molds before dissection.
Euthanize mouse with carbon dioxide chamber.
Place mouse on a surgical board and sterilize the body using 70% ethanol.
Open the skin and expose the chest cavity using tweezers and dissecting scissors.
Cut through the ribcage to expose the heart.
Insert the 21-g needle into the apex of the left ventricle with a syringe containing 30 mL PBS.
Cut the right atrium to let blood flow out.
Start injecting PBS into the lumen of ventricle slowly.
Rinse the coelom with PBS and remove extra liquid with sterile gauze.
Transfer the mouse into the platform of dissection microscope.
Separate the aorta from the dorsal surface of the coelom with sterile micro-scissors and micro-forceps.
Carefully remove the perivascular adipose tissue along the aorta while avoiding cutting the aortic wall.
Exposure of heart and aorta after perfusion and removing adipose tissue.
Cut the aorta above the base of the heart, ensuring the integrity of the aortic arch, innominate artery, carotid arteries, and subclavian arteries.
Transfer the aorta immediately into a 1.7 mL tube filled with pre-cooled DMEM medium and keep on ice before digestion.
Take the heart and cut it into halves using a razor.
Place half of the heart into a base mold ensuring the heart lies vertically inside with the aortic root at the bottom.
Add sufficient OCT medium to embed all tissues within.
Put the chamber containing the heart into -80°C freezer for frozen sectioning.
Remove perivascular adipose tissue from the aorta to prevent contamination from adipose tissue macrophages.
Place the aorta in a sterile dish with 0.5 ml of digestion buffer.
Mince the aorta finely using a razor.
Transfer the aorta into a 15 mL tube using a pipette.
Centrifuge at 700 rpm (50 × g) for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and add 3 mL of pre-warmed digestion buffer to re-suspend the pellet.
Place the tube on a shaker at 37°C to digest the aorta, shaking every 10 minutes as needed (digestion may take 30–40 minutes).
Prepare a 50 mL tube containing 5 mL of pre-cooled complete DMEM and place a 70 μM cell strainer into it.
After digestion, add the mixture through the cell strainer into the prepared 50 mL tube.
Wash the strainer once with 2 mL of pre-chilled DMEM Complete Medium.
Add 500 μM EDTA to the strained mixture to a final concentration of 1 μM and mix well to stop digestion.
Centrifuge the mixture at 700 rpm (50 × g) for 5 minutes at 4°C, remove the supernatant, and re-suspend the pellet with 1 mL red cell lysis buffer in a 15 mL Eppendorf tube.
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Add 5 mL of cold FACS buffer to the cells and centrifuge again at 700 rpm (50 × g) for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard all supernatant, keep the cell pellet on ice.
Re-suspend the cell pellet with 10 μL Fc block solution in a new tube, keeping it on ice.
Incubate in the dark for 5 minutes.
Add 90 μL prepared antibody cocktail into the tube.
Mix well.
Incubate on ice in the dark for 30 min.
Add 500 μL FACS buffer into the mixture.
Wash cells twice by centrifuging at 2500 rpm (630 × g) for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard all supernatant.
Add 500 μL 2% PFA to re-suspend cells while vortexing gently.
Keep tube in the dark at 4°C before intracellular staining.
Centrifuge fixed cells at 5000 rpm (2,400 × g) for 5 min at 25°C.
Remove all supernatant and wash pellets with 1 mL PBS.
Discard supernatant and add 500 μL permeabilization/blocking buffer to re-suspend the pellets.
Incubate at 25°C in the dark for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 5000 rpm (2,400 × g) for 5 min at 25°C.
Remove all supernatant and add 100 μL anti-mouse p-S6 (1:150 diluted in permeabilization/blocking buffer).
Mix well and incubate at 25°C in the dark for 30 min.
Wash cells by adding 500 μL washing buffer and centrifuge at 5000 rpm (2,400 × g) for 5 min at 25°C.
Repeat wash step once more.
Discard all the supernatant and add 100 μL Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated secondary antibody (1:200 diluted in permeabilization/blocking buffer).
Mix well and incubate at 25°C in the dark for 30 min.
Wash the cells twice with 500 μL washing buffer.
Remove all liquids after washing and re-suspend the cells in 300 μL washing buffer.
Filter the cell suspension through a 70-mm cell strainer into a 50 mL tube.
Transfer the liquid into a 5 mL FACS flow tube.
Analyze the samples with a flow cytometer.
Make frozen sections (10 μm) using a cryostat.
Start collecting sections when plaque lesion appears and stop when most of lesion areas are gone.
Embed the selected slide containing the largest lesion area into 10 ml pre-chilled 4% PFA at 4°C for 15 min.
Wash the slide three times by adding pre-chilled (4°C) PBS onto the surface with subsequent gentle shaking every 1-2 min.
Block/permeabilize the sections in Roth Buffer at 25°C for 1 h.
Incubate the slide with rat anti-mouse CD68 antibody diluted 1:250 in Roth buffer at 25°C for 2 h.
Wash the slide with cold PBS for 5 min.
Repeat washing twice.
Incubate the slide with Alexa Fluor 594 conjugated goat anti Rat IgG diluted at 1:250 in Roth buffer at 25°C for 1 h.
Wash the slide with cold PBS for 5 min.
Repeat washing twice.
Incubate the slide with Rabbit anti-mouse phosphor-RPS6 diluted at 1:100 in Roth buffer at 25°C for 2 h.
Optional: Incubation can be done at 4°C for 12 h, then transfer slides to 37°C for 30 min before moving to the next step.
Wash the slide with cold PBS for 5 min.
Repeat washing twice.
Incubate the slide with Alexa Fluor 488 conjugated goat anti Rabbit IgG diluted at 1:200 in Roth buffer at 25°C for 1 h.
Wash the slide with cold PBS for 5 min.
Repeat washing twice.
Stain the nucleus using 1× DAPI stock in PBS for 3 min at room temperature.
Wash the slide with cold PBS for 5 min.
Repeat washing twice.
Remove all liquid on the surface of sections.
Lay one drop of Vectashield® fluorescence mounting medium around the sections on the slide.
Slowly put the coverslip on the slide.
Dry the slide in the dark for 4 h.
